visual_identity.core_identity: A rooted predatory fungus that resembles an ordinary large mushroom until several long whip-like tendrils lash from its body.
visual_identity.silhouette: Thick mushroom stalk and cap with multiple long narrow tendrils extending outward in sweeping curves.
visual_identity.head_features: No head, eyes, or mouth; cap remains mushroom-like.
visual_identity.body_shape: Rooted fungal stalk with cap and four or more flexible tendrils emerging around the upper stalk.
visual_identity.surface: Simple cap and stalk with sparse spots; tendrils smooth and uncluttered.
must_keep: clear contrast between cap and tendrils

accuracy_checks: tendrils do not tangle into clutter

reference.notes: Reference material controls creature identity, anatomy, and silhouette only; Black-Ink controls the final coloring-book rendering style.
